_comment: Node slugs published as PalmasMesh.com/<slug> — the long name every node
PRIVACY RULE — Tim, 2026-08-05. NO PERSONALLY IDENTIFIABLE INFORMATION HERE
OR ON A NODE PAGE WITHOUT THAT HOST'S EXPLICIT APPROVAL. No host names, no
unit or street addresses, no coordinates. A stranger may learn that a node
exists, never who hosts it. Host attribution is welcome ONLY where the host
has agreed to it in advance — add it then, not before.
'slug' is canonical and CASE-SENSITIVE, exactly as the node broadcasts it.
Lowercase aliases are generated automatically; do not list them by hand.
'live' means the node is on the air carrying this name TODAY. A planned
rename gets its page early on purpose — the URL then works the moment the
node is renamed, which is the whole point of the wildcard route.
TO ADD A NODE: append an entry. That is the entire task.
